title: Sloth eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Branch -->
  <rect x="5" y="62" width="90" height="8" rx="4" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="5" y="62" width="90" height="3" rx="2" fill="#A87A56"/>
  
  <!-- Sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#9E8B6E"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  
  <!-- Sloth tummy -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#CDBFAD"/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="16" ry="13" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="28" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#CDBFAD"/>
  
  <!-- Face mask (darker around eyes) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="28" rx="11" ry="8" fill="#8B7A5E"/>
  
  <!-- Eye patches (light) -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="27" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#2B2B2B"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="27" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#2B2B2B"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes (glowing dots) -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="27" r="2" fill="#7CFC00"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="27" r="2" fill="#7CFC00"/>
  <circle cx="44.7" cy="26.3" r="0.7" fill="#FFFFAA"/>
  <circle cx="56.7" cy="26.3" r="0.7" fill="#FFFFAA"/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#5E4E3A"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M46 35 Q50 38 54 35" stroke="#5E4E3A" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="28" r="4" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="28" r="4" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#CDBFAD"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#CDBFAD"/>
  
  <!-- Left arm holding branch -->
  <path d="M32 48 Q22 56 20 64" stroke="#9E8B6E" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M32 48 Q22 56 20 64" stroke="#B8A88A" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Claws on left hand -->
  <line x1="18" y1="62" x2="16" y2="68" stroke="#8B7A5E" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="63" x2="19" y2="69" stroke="#8B7A5E" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="63" x2="22" y2="69" stroke="#8B7A5E" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Right arm holding snack -->
  <path d="M68 48 Q78 52 76 60" stroke="#9E8B6E" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M68 48 Q78 52 76 60" stroke="#B8A88A" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Snack (leaf/berry) in right hand -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="62" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#4CAF50" transform="rotate(-20 78 62)"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="62" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#66BB6A" transform="rotate(-20 78 62)"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="60" r="2" fill="#E53935"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="60" r="1" fill="#FF8A80"/>
  
  <!-- Bite mark on snack -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="64" r="2" fill="#2B2B2B"/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <path d="M36 66 Q34 72 32 74" stroke="#9E8B6E" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64 66 Q66 72 68 74" stroke="#9E8B6E" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Claws on legs -->
  <line x1="30" y1="73" x2="29" y2="78" stroke="#8B7A5E" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="32" y1="74" x2="32" y2="79" stroke="#8B7A5E" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="73" x2="71" y2="78" stroke="#8B7A5E" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="68" y1="74" x2="68" y2="79" stroke="#8B7A5E" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Leaves on branch -->
  <ellipse cx="15" cy="58" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#4CAF50" transform="rotate(-30 15 58)"/>
  <ellipse cx="85" cy="60" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#66BB6A" transform="rotate(20 85 60)"/>
</svg>
